title: CTA Chest PE protocol
text:
EXAM: CTA CHEST WITH CONTRAST (PE PROTOCOL)
CLINICAL HISTORY: 58-year-old male with pleuritic chest pain, elevated D-dimer. 30 pack-year former smoker, quit 2019.
TECHNIQUE: Helical CT of the chest after IV administration of 75 mL Omnipaque 350 using a pulmonary arterial bolus-tracking protocol. Axial, coronal and sagittal MIP reconstructions.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
PULMONARY ARTERIES: Adequate opacification to the subsegmental level. No filling defect to suggest pulmonary embolism. Main PA 2.7 cm.
LUNGS AND AIRWAYS: Mild centrilobular emphysema, upper lobe predominant. There is a 7 mm solid noncalcified nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment (series 4, image 61). No consolidation. Airways patent.
PLEURA: No effusion or pneumothorax.
HEART AND MEDIASTINUM: Normal heart size. No pericardial effusion. No mediastinal or hilar adenopathy by size criteria.
UPPER ABDOMEN: Unremarkable.
BONES: Degenerative change of the thoracic spine.
IMPRESSION:
1. No pulmonary embolism.
2. 7 mm solid right upper lobe nodule in a high-risk patient (former heavy smoker).
3. Mild centrilobular emphysema.
RECOMMENDATION: Per Fleischner Society 2017 guidelines for a single 6-8 mm solid nodule in a high-risk patient, recommend non-contrast CT chest in 6-12 months, then consider CT at 18-24 months.
rationale: Single solid 6-8 mm nodule, high risk: Fleischner CT at 6-12 months; explicit CT recommendation.

title: 흉부 CT (조영증강)
text:
검사명: Chest CT (enhanced)
임상정보: 64세 남자, 흡연 40갑년. 우하엽 결절 f/u.
비교: 2025-12-08 chest CT

판독소견:
RLL superior segment에 1.2 cm part-solid nodule 있으며 solid component 7 mm로 측정됨 (이전 1.2 cm, solid portion 6 mm). 3개월 간격에도 소실되지 않고 persistent함.
그 외 양폐야에 새로운 결절 없음. Mediastinal/hilar LN enlargement 없음.
Pleural effusion 없음. 갑상선, 상복부 특이소견 없음.

결론:
1. RLL persistent part-solid nodule, solid component 7 mm — r/o invasive adenocarcinoma.
2. 그 외 특이소견 없음.

권고: PET-CT 및 조직검사(PCNB) 권함. 흉부외과/호흡기내과 협진 요망.
rationale: Persistent part-solid nodule with solid component >=6 mm needs PET/CT, tissue sampling or referral (escalation rule, not routine R003).

title: 저선량 흉부 CT (폐암검진)
text:
검사명: Low-dose chest CT for lung cancer screening (baseline)
임상정보: 70세 여자, 과거 흡연 35갑년 (2015년 금연). 국가폐암검진.
비교: 없음 (baseline)

판독소견:
- LUL apicoposterior segment: 7 mm solid nodule (mean diameter, series 3 image 42). 석회화 없음.
- 그 외 폐실질: mild paraseptal emphysema.
- 기관지: 특이소견 없음.
- 종격동: 관상동맥 석회화 (moderate).
- 그 외: 특이소견 없음.

결론:
Lung-RADS v2022 category 3 (probably benign) — baseline solid nodule 6~<8 mm.
S modifier: coronary artery calcification, moderate.

권고: 6개월 후 LDCT f/u 권함.
rationale: Lung-RADS 3 on baseline screening LDCT: 6-month LDCT; explicit CT recommendation.

title: LDCT Lung Cancer Screening
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST LOW DOSE LUNG CANCER SCREENING
CLINICAL HISTORY: Annual lung cancer screening. Current smoker, 45 pack-years. Asymptomatic.
TECHNIQUE: Low-dose non-contrast helical CT of the chest, CTDIvol 1.4 mGy.
COMPARISON: None available; baseline examination.
FINDINGS:
LUNGS: 9 mm solid nodule in the right middle lobe lateral segment (image 88), smooth margins, no calcification or fat. Additional 3 mm subpleural nodule in the left lower lobe. Mild centrilobular emphysema.
PLEURA: No effusion.
MEDIASTINUM: No adenopathy. Mild coronary artery calcification.
OTHER: Small hiatal hernia.
IMPRESSION:
Lung-RADS Category: 4A (suspicious). Baseline solid nodule 8 to <15 mm.
Significant/other findings (S): mild coronary artery calcification.
RECOMMENDATION: 3-month low-dose CT; PET/CT may be used if there is a >= 8 mm solid component.
rationale: Lung-RADS 4A: 3-month LDCT; CT recommended.

title: 저선량 흉부 CT
text:
LDCT 폐암검진 판독
임상정보: 68M, current smoker 50PY
비교: 2025-05-02 LDCT

판독소견:
RUL anterior segment 17 mm solid nodule, spiculated margin. 이전 검사에서는 보이지 않던 new nodule임.
양측 상엽 centrilobular emphysema.
Mediastinum: 우측 lower paratracheal LN 9 mm (short axis), borderline.
기타 특이소견 없음.

결론:
Lung-RADS 4B — new solid nodule ≥8 mm (17 mm), spiculated.
r/o lung cancer.

권고: Contrast-enhanced chest CT 또는 PET-CT 및 조직검사 고려 요망. 호흡기내과 의뢰 권함.
rationale: Lung-RADS 4B requires diagnostic work-up (PET/CT, tissue, referral).

title: LDCT Lung Screening Annual
text:
EXAM: LOW-DOSE CT CHEST FOR LUNG CANCER SCREENING
HISTORY: Former smoker, 25 pack-years, quit 8 years ago. Annual screening.
COMPARISON: LDCT 2025-05-14.
FINDINGS: Two solid nodules: 4 mm right upper lobe (image 33) and 3 mm left lower lobe (image 102), both unchanged from prior. No new nodules. No consolidation or effusion. No mediastinal adenopathy. No significant incidental findings.
IMPRESSION:
Lung-RADS 2 (benign appearance or behavior). Stable small solid nodules.
RECOMMENDATION: Continue annual screening with LDCT in 12 months.
rationale: Lung-RADS 2: routine continuation of annual screening, no finding-driven follow-up obligation.

title: Chest PA
text:
Chest PA & Lat
임상: fever, cough 5일. CRP 12.
비교: 없음

판독소견:
RLL에 consolidation with air-bronchogram 있음. 우측 CP angle blunting, small amount of effusion 가능성.
심장 크기 정상. 골 구조물 특이소견 없음.

결론:
RLL pneumonia, c/w lobar pneumonia.
Small Rt pleural effusion.

권고: 항생제 치료 후 6주 뒤 f/u CXR 권함 (resolution 확인 및 underlying lesion 배제 위해).
rationale: Radiologist recommends repeat radiograph in 6 weeks to document resolution.

title: CT Head without contrast - ED prelim
text:
CT HEAD WO - PRELIMINARY (ED)
Hx: fall on anticoag, GCS 13.
Prelim: Acute L convexity subdural hematoma, max thickness 9 mm, 5 mm L->R midline shift. Mild effacement of L lateral ventricle. No skull fx seen.
Critical result called to Dr. Reyes (ED) at 02:14 by phone, read-back confirmed.
Final to follow.
rationale: Acute SDH with midline shift is a critical finding requiring documented communication (documented in report).

title: CTA Chest PE protocol
text:
EXAM: CT ANGIOGRAPHY CHEST
CLINICAL HISTORY: 45F, dyspnea after long-haul flight. Never smoker.
TECHNIQUE: CTA chest with 70 mL IV contrast.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
Pulmonary arteries: Well opacified. No pulmonary embolus.
Lungs: 4 mm solid nodule in the left lower lobe (series 5, image 140). Minimal dependent atelectasis. No consolidation.
Pleura: No effusion. No pneumothorax.
Heart/mediastinum: Normal.
Upper abdomen: Small hepatic cyst.
IMPRESSION:
1. No pulmonary embolism.
2. 4 mm solid pulmonary nodule. In a low-risk patient, no routine follow-up is required per Fleischner Society 2017 guidelines.
rationale: PE negative; <6 mm solid nodule in low-risk patient needs no follow-up.

title: 복부 CT (조영증강)
text:
검사명: Abdomen-Pelvis CT, enhanced (portal phase)
임상정보: 62F, epigastric pain. 암 병력 없음.
비교: 없음

판독소견:
Liver: 특이소견 없음.
GB/bile duct: GB stone 1개, 담낭염 소견 없음.
Pancreas, spleen: 특이소견 없음.
Adrenal: Rt adrenal에 2.4 cm 크기의 oval nodule, portal phase 75 HU. Unenhanced image 없어 adenoma 여부 판단 불가. 이전 영상 없음.
Kidney: 특이소견 없음.
Bowel, peritoneum: 특이소견 없음.

결론:
1. Rt adrenal 2.4 cm indeterminate nodule.
2. GB stone without cholecystitis.

권고: Rt adrenal nodule 감별 위해 adrenal protocol CT (unenhanced + washout) 권함.
rationale: Indeterminate adrenal nodule 2-4 cm without cancer history: characterise with adrenal protocol CT (proposed 90 days).

title: CT Abdomen Pelvis with contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN AND PELVIS WITHOUT AND WITH IV CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Hematuria.
TECHNIQUE: Unenhanced, nephrographic and excretory phases.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
LIVER: Normal.
ADRENALS: 1.4 cm left adrenal nodule measuring 6 HU on unenhanced images, consistent with a lipid-rich adenoma.
KIDNEYS: 2.1 cm simple cyst of the right lower pole (4 HU, no enhancement, Bosniak I). No hydronephrosis. No urolithiasis. No urothelial filling defect.
BLADDER: Normal.
PANCREAS, SPLEEN: Normal.
BOWEL: Sigmoid diverticulosis without diverticulitis.
IMPRESSION:
1. No source of hematuria identified on CT.
2. 1.4 cm left adrenal adenoma (6 HU). No imaging follow-up is needed.
3. Bosniak I right renal cyst, no follow-up required.
rationale: Lipid-rich adrenal adenoma (<=10 HU) and Bosniak I cyst are benign; explicit no-follow-up.

title: CT Chest Abdomen Pelvis - staging
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST, ABDOMEN AND PELVIS WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Newly diagnosed sigmoid adenocarcinoma. Staging.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
CHEST: No pulmonary nodules. No adenopathy. No effusion.
LIVER: No focal lesion.
ADRENALS: 1.6 cm right adrenal nodule, 48 HU on portal venous phase. No prior for comparison. Left adrenal normal.
KIDNEYS, PANCREAS, SPLEEN: Unremarkable.
BOWEL: Circumferential wall thickening of the sigmoid colon over 5 cm with pericolic stranding and two 7 mm pericolic nodes, compatible with known primary.
IMPRESSION:
1. Known sigmoid carcinoma with locoregional nodes.
2. 1.6 cm indeterminate right adrenal nodule in a patient with known malignancy; metastasis not excluded.
RECOMMENDATION: FDG PET/CT or adrenal chemical-shift MRI for characterization; tissue sampling if indeterminate.
rationale: Adrenal nodule >=1 cm in a patient with cancer: specialist work-up (escalation rule).

title: 복부 CT
text:
Abdomen CT (dynamic, renal protocol 아님)
임상: 59M, 건강검진 US상 Lt kidney mass 의심.

판독소견:
Lt kidney upper pole에 3.1 cm exophytic solid mass, heterogeneous enhancement (unenh 34 HU → nephrographic 112 HU). 지방 성분 없음.
Lt renal vein, IVC 침범 없음. Regional LN enlargement 없음.
Rt kidney: 1 cm 미만 cyst 수개, too small to characterize.
Liver, pancreas: 특이소견 없음.

결론:
1. Lt renal enhancing solid mass 3.1 cm — r/o RCC (cT1a).
2. Rt renal small cysts.

비뇨의학과 협진 요망.
rationale: Solid enhancing renal mass needs urology referral.

title: US Retroperitoneum (Renal)
text:
EXAM: US RENAL COMPLETE
HISTORY: Flank pain.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
Right kidney: 10.8 cm. Normal echogenicity. No hydronephrosis.
Left kidney: 11.2 cm. 2.2 cm cystic lesion in the interpolar region with two thin internal septations and possible mildly thickened wall segment; internal vascularity cannot be assessed reliably. No hydronephrosis. No stones.
Bladder: Partially distended, unremarkable.
IMPRESSION:
1. 2.2 cm complex cystic lesion of the left kidney, indeterminate by ultrasound (Bosniak classification cannot be assigned on US).
RECOMMENDATION: Renal mass protocol MRI for further characterization.
rationale: Indeterminate renal lesion >=1 cm: renal mass protocol MRI recommended.

title: CT Abdomen renal mass protocol
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN RENAL MASS PROTOCOL
CLINICAL HISTORY: Complex renal cyst on outside ultrasound.
TECHNIQUE: Unenhanced, corticomedullary and nephrographic phases.
COMPARISON: Outside US 2026-03-30 (report only).
FINDINGS:
Right kidney: 3.0 cm cyst of the lower pole with multiple (>4) thin, smooth enhancing septa and no measurable enhancing nodule. Wall smooth, 2 mm.
Left kidney: Normal.
Adrenals, liver, pancreas: Normal.
IMPRESSION:
Bosniak IIF right renal cyst (v2019), 3.0 cm.
RECOMMENDATION: Follow-up renal mass protocol CT in 6 months, then annually for 5 years if stable.
rationale: Bosniak IIF: 6-month CT/MRI; explicit CT follow-up.

title: MRI 췌장 / MRCP
text:
검사명: Pancreas MRI with MRCP
임상정보: 66F, 타병원 CT에서 우연히 발견된 pancreatic cyst.
비교: 외부 CT 2026-04-02 (영상 판독 참고)

판독소견:
Pancreas body에 1.2 cm unilocular cystic lesion, MPD와 communication 의심 → r/o side-branch IPMN.
Enhancing mural nodule 없음. Thickened/enhancing cyst wall 없음. MPD 직경 2 mm, 정상.
Liver, CBD: 특이소견 없음.

결론:
Pancreatic body 1.2 cm cyst, probable BD-IPMN, without worrisome features or high-risk stigmata.

권고: 2년 후 MRI/MRCP f/u 권함 (ACR 2017 기준 <1.5 cm).
rationale: Pancreatic cyst <1.5 cm: MRI/MRCP in 2 years; MRI explicitly recommended.

title: CT Abdomen Pelvis with contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN/PELVIS WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Weight loss, epigastric discomfort.
COMPARISON: CT 2024-08-11.
FINDINGS:
PANCREAS: Multilocular cystic lesion of the pancreatic head measuring 2.8 cm (previously 1.9 cm), containing a 5 mm enhancing mural nodule. Main pancreatic duct dilated to 6 mm (previously 3 mm). No pancreatic atrophy.
LIVER/BILIARY: No intrahepatic biliary dilatation. CBD 6 mm.
SPLEEN, ADRENALS, KIDNEYS: Normal.
VASCULATURE: No arterial encasement.
IMPRESSION:
Enlarging pancreatic head cystic lesion (1.9 -> 2.8 cm) with enhancing mural nodule and main duct dilatation, worrisome for IPMN with high-risk features.
RECOMMENDATION: Endoscopic ultrasound with FNA and pancreatic surgery consultation.
rationale: Pancreatic cyst with enhancing mural nodule and growth: EUS/pancreas specialist (escalation rule).

title: CT Neck Soft Tissue with contrast
text:
EXAM: CT SOFT TISSUE NECK WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Sore throat, rule out peritonsillar abscess.
TECHNIQUE: Axial images from skull base to thoracic inlet after IV contrast.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
PHARYNX: Mild bilateral tonsillar enlargement with striated enhancement. No rim-enhancing fluid collection.
LYMPH NODES: Reactive-appearing level II nodes bilaterally, up to 11 mm short axis.
THYROID: 1.8 cm heterogeneous nodule in the left thyroid lobe. Right lobe normal.
SALIVARY GLANDS: Normal.
BONES/AIRWAY: Unremarkable.
IMPRESSION:
1. Acute tonsillitis without abscess.
2. 1.8 cm left thyroid nodule.
RECOMMENDATION: Dedicated thyroid ultrasound for the incidental thyroid nodule (ACR incidental thyroid nodule guidance, >=1.5 cm in patient >=35 years).
rationale: Incidental thyroid nodule >=1.5 cm on CT: thyroid ultrasound.

title: 갑상선 초음파
text:
Thyroid US
임상: 건강검진 갑상선 결절, 추가평가.

판독소견:
Rt lobe mid portion: 1.7 x 1.3 x 1.2 cm solid hypoechoic (marked hypoechogenicity) nodule, irregular margin, taller-than-wide, punctate echogenic foci (+).
ACR TI-RADS: composition 2 + echogenicity 3 + shape 3 + margin 2 + echogenic foci 3 = 13 points → TR5.
Lt lobe: 4 mm cyst.
Cervical LN: suspicious LN 없음.

결론:
Rt thyroid nodule 1.7 cm, ACR TI-RADS TR5 — r/o PTC.
(TR5 FNA 기준 ≥1.0 cm 충족)

권고: US-guided FNA 권함.
rationale: TI-RADS TR5 >=1 cm: FNA recommended.

title: 갑상선 초음파
text:
갑상선 초음파 판독지
비교: 2025-06-10 thyroid US

소견:
Lt lobe: 1.2 cm mixed cystic and solid, isoechoic, smooth margin, no echogenic foci. 이전 1.1 cm, 큰 변화 없음.
ACR TI-RADS 2 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 = 3 points → TR3.
Rt lobe: 특이소견 없음.

결론:
Lt thyroid nodule 1.2 cm, TR3.
TR3 기준 FNA threshold 2.5 cm 및 f/u threshold 1.5 cm 모두 미만으로 추가 f/u 필요 없음.
rationale: TR3 nodule below both the 1.5 cm follow-up and 2.5 cm FNA thresholds: no action.

title: US Thyroid
text:
EXAM: ULTRASOUND THYROID
CLINICAL HISTORY: Palpable fullness, right neck.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
Right lobe: 4.9 x 1.8 x 1.7 cm. 1.2 cm solid, hypoechoic nodule, smooth margins, wider-than-tall, no echogenic foci. TI-RADS points: 2 + 2 + 0 + 0 + 0 = 4 (TR4).
Left lobe: 4.6 x 1.6 x 1.5 cm, no nodules.
Isthmus: 3 mm.
Lymph nodes: No abnormal cervical nodes.
IMPRESSION:
1.2 cm right thyroid nodule, ACR TI-RADS TR4. This is below the 1.5 cm FNA threshold but meets the 1.0 cm threshold for surveillance.
RECOMMENDATION: Follow-up thyroid ultrasound in 1 year.
rationale: TR4 1.0-1.4 cm: no FNA, ultrasound follow-up at 1 year.

title: CT Abdomen Pelvis with contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN AND PELVIS WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Left lower quadrant pain, r/o diverticulitis.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
BOWEL: Sigmoid diverticulosis with mild pericolic fat stranding adjacent to a mid-sigmoid diverticulum; no abscess or free air.
VASCULATURE: Infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm measuring 3.7 x 3.6 cm (maximal outer-to-outer), with mural thrombus. No periaortic stranding. Iliac arteries 1.4 cm.
LIVER, PANCREAS, KIDNEYS, ADRENALS: Unremarkable.
IMPRESSION:
1. Acute uncomplicated sigmoid diverticulitis.
2. 3.7 cm infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm.
RECOMMENDATION: Ultrasound surveillance of the AAA in 2 years (SVS guideline interval for 3.5-3.9 cm).
rationale: AAA 3.5-3.9 cm: surveillance in 2 years; US recommended.

title: 복부 CT
text:
Abdomen-pelvis CT (enhanced)
임상: 77M, 요통.

판독소견:
Infrarenal AAA, maximal diameter 5.8 cm (outer-to-outer), eccentric mural thrombus 동반. 주위 hematoma나 fat stranding 없음 → rupture 소견 없음.
Both CIA 1.6 cm.
L-spine: L3-4, L4-5 degenerative change.
그 외 장기 특이소견 없음.

결론:
1. Infrarenal AAA 5.8 cm, no evidence of rupture.
2. L-spine spondylosis.

권고: 수술 기준(5.5 cm) 이상으로 혈관외과 의뢰 요망.
rationale: Asymptomatic AAA >=5.5 cm: vascular surgery referral.

title: CTA Abdomen Pelvis
text:
CTA ABDOMEN/PELVIS - STAT
HISTORY: Hypotension, acute back pain, pulsatile mass.
FINDINGS: 7.4 cm infrarenal AAA with large left retroperitoneal hematoma extending into the perirenal space and active contrast extravasation from the left posterolateral wall. Draped aorta sign.
IMPRESSION:
Ruptured infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm with active extravasation.
Discussed with Dr. Patel, vascular surgery, at 21:47 by telephone; patient being taken to OR.
rationale: Ruptured AAA is a critical finding (R035); also AAA above repair threshold requiring vascular surgery (R045).

title: Screening Mammogram Bilateral
text:
EXAM: BILATERAL SCREENING MAMMOGRAM WITH TOMOSYNTHESIS
HISTORY: Routine screening. No symptoms.
COMPARISON: 2025-06-30, 2024-07-02.
BREAST COMPOSITION: Scattered areas of fibroglandular density (b).
FINDINGS: No suspicious masses, calcifications, or architectural distortion in either breast. Stable benign-appearing intramammary lymph node, right upper outer quadrant.
IMPRESSION: Negative.
BI-RADS 1: Negative.
RECOMMENDATION: Routine annual screening mammography.
rationale: BI-RADS 1 negative screening; routine annual screening only.

title: 유방촬영술 및 유방초음파
text:
Mammography (Bilateral) + Breast US
임상: Lt breast palpable mass.
비교: 2024 mammo (외부)

판독소견:
Mammo: Heterogeneously dense breast (c). Lt UOQ에 1.4 cm irregular high-density mass with spiculated margin. 이전 영상에서는 보이지 않음.
US: Lt 2시 방향 FN 6 cm, 1.4 x 1.2 cm irregular, non-parallel, hypoechoic mass with angular margin, posterior shadowing. Lt axilla LN cortical thickening 없음.
Rt breast: 특이소견 없음.

결론:
Lt breast 2 o'clock 1.4 cm mass, BI-RADS category 5 (highly suggestive of malignancy).

권고: US-guided core needle biopsy 권함.
rationale: BI-RADS 5: tissue diagnosis (R018 governs, not R036).

title: US Breast Left Diagnostic
text:
EXAM: ULTRASOUND LEFT BREAST, TARGETED
HISTORY: 34F, palpable lump left breast 10 o'clock, first noticed 2 weeks ago.
FINDINGS: At the site of palpable concern, left breast 10 o'clock 4 cm from nipple, there is an 8 x 5 x 4 mm oval, circumscribed, parallel, hypoechoic mass without posterior features or internal vascularity, compatible with probable fibroadenoma. No axillary adenopathy.
IMPRESSION:
Probably benign left breast mass, likely fibroadenoma.
BI-RADS 3: Probably benign.
RECOMMENDATION: Short-interval follow-up left breast ultrasound in 6 months.
rationale: BI-RADS 3 on US: 6-month follow-up ultrasound (not BI-RADS 4/5).

title: Diagnostic Mammogram Right
text:
EXAM: DIAGNOSTIC MAMMOGRAM RIGHT BREAST WITH MAGNIFICATION VIEWS
HISTORY: Recall from screening 2026-07-08 for calcifications.
FINDINGS: Magnification CC and ML views demonstrate a 9 mm group of fine pleomorphic calcifications in the right breast upper outer quadrant, middle depth, in a grouped distribution. No associated mass. No new findings elsewhere.
IMPRESSION:
Suspicious grouped fine pleomorphic calcifications, right breast UOQ.
BI-RADS 4B: Moderate suspicion for malignancy.
RECOMMENDATION: Stereotactic biopsy is recommended. Results were discussed with the patient at the time of the exam.
rationale: BI-RADS 4B requires stereotactic biopsy.

title: 간 MRI (Gd-EOB)
text:
Liver MRI (primovist)
임상: HBV LC, HCC surveillance. 초음파에서 S6 nodule 의심.
비교: 2026-01 Liver US

판독소견:
S6에 1.6 cm nodule: arterial phase hyperenhancement (nonrim) 있으나 nonperipheral washout 및 enhancing capsule 없음. HBP hypointensity. T2 mild hyperintensity.
Liver surface nodular, splenomegaly (14 cm), small varices.
Ascites 없음. PV patent.

결론:
1. S6 1.6 cm observation — LI-RADS LR-3 (intermediate probability).
2. Liver cirrhosis with portal hypertension.

권고: 3-6개월 후 multiphasic MRI f/u 권함.
rationale: LR-3: repeat MRI in 3-6 months.

title: MRI Liver with contrast
text:
EXAM: MRI ABDOMEN WITH AND WITHOUT CONTRAST (LIVER PROTOCOL)
CLINICAL HISTORY: Hepatitis C cirrhosis, rising AFP.
COMPARISON: MRI 2026-02-02.
FINDINGS:
LIVER: Cirrhotic morphology. Segment 8 observation measuring 2.4 cm (previously 1.1 cm) with nonrim arterial phase hyperenhancement, nonperipheral washout on portal venous phase and an enhancing capsule. No tumor in vein. Portal veins patent.

FINDINGS:
CHEST: New 6 mm solid nodule in the right lower lobe (image 101), not present on 2026-01-20. Postsurgical changes left breast. No adenopathy. No effusion.
ABDOMEN/PELVIS: No hepatic lesions. No adenopathy. No osseous lesions.
IMPRESSION:
1. New 6 mm right lower lobe nodule; metastasis cannot be excluded in this patient with known breast cancer. Fleischner guidelines do not apply.
2. No other evidence of metastatic disease.
RECOMMENDATION: Short-interval CT chest in 3 months.
rationale: Known malignancy: Fleischner excluded; explicit 3-month CT recommendation.

title: 유방초음파
text:
Breast US (Bilateral)
임상: 건강검진 유방초음파.

판독소견:
Rt breast 10시 방향 FN 3 cm: 0.9 x 0.6 cm oval, not circumscribed (microlobulated margin), hypoechoic mass, parallel orientation. Vascularity (+).
Lt breast: 수개의 simple cyst (최대 6 mm).
Both axilla: 특이소견 없음.

결론:
1. Rt breast 10 o'clock 0.9 cm mass, BI-RADS 4A (low suspicion).
2. Lt breast simple cysts, BI-RADS 2.

권고: Rt breast mass에 대해 US-guided CNB 권함.
rationale: BI-RADS 4A: tissue diagnosis.

title: CT Abdomen Pelvis with contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN AND PELVIS WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Right lower quadrant pain.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
APPENDIX: Normal.
BOWEL: Normal.
VASCULATURE: Ectatic infrarenal abdominal aorta measuring 2.8 cm. Mild atherosclerosis.
LIVER, PANCREAS, KIDNEYS, ADRENALS, SPLEEN: Unremarkable.
IMPRESSION:
1. No acute abnormality to explain right lower quadrant pain.
2. Infrarenal aortic ectasia/small aneurysm, 2.8 cm.
RECOMMENDATION: Surveillance ultrasound in 5 years (SVS, 2.5-2.9 cm).
rationale: Aortic diameter 2.5-2.9 cm: surveillance in 5 years.

title: CT Chest with contrast
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Dyspnea.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
AORTA: Ascending thoracic aorta measures 4.6 cm at the level of the right pulmonary artery. Aortic arch 3.3 cm. Descending thoracic aorta 2.9 cm. No dissection.
LUNGS: Mild dependent atelectasis. No nodules.
HEART: Mild cardiomegaly, no pericardial effusion.
UPPER ABDOMEN: Abdominal aorta at the diaphragmatic hiatus 2.2 cm.
IMPRESSION:
1. 4.6 cm ascending thoracic aortic aneurysm.
RECOMMENDATION: Annual CT or MR angiography of the thoracic aorta; consider cardiothoracic surgery consultation. Next study in 12 months.
rationale: Thoracic (not abdominal) aneurysm: AAA rules do not apply; annual CT angiography recommended (CT listed as named first).

title: 부신 CT
text:
Adrenal protocol CT
임상: 고혈압, 타병원 US상 Lt suprarenal mass.

판독소견:
Lt adrenal 4.8 x 4.1 cm heterogeneous enhancing mass, unenhanced 38 HU, central necrosis 의심, 미세 석회화 동반.
Absolute washout 42%, relative washout 25% → adenoma criteria 미충족.
Rt adrenal: 정상.
LN enlargement 없음. Liver metastasis 없음.

결론:
Lt adrenal 4.8 cm indeterminate mass — r/o adrenocortical carcinoma, pheochromocytoma.

권고: 내분비내과 협진 및 adrenalectomy 고려, hormonal w/u 요망.
rationale: Adrenal mass >=4 cm: specialist work-up.

title: 요추 MRI
text:
L-spine MRI (non-enhanced)
임상: LBP with Rt leg radiating pain.

판독소견:
L4-5: central to Rt subarticular disc protrusion → Rt L5 nerve root compression.
L5-S1: mild disc bulging, neural foraminal stenosis 없음.
Vertebral body marrow signal 정상.
Incidental: Lt kidney lower pole 2.5 cm T2 homogeneous hyperintense, thin wall lesion → simple cyst (Bosniak I) 가능성 높음. f/u 불필요.

결론:
1. L4-5 disc protrusion with Rt L5 root compression.
2. Lt renal simple cyst (incidental).
rationale: Incidental simple renal cyst; explicit no follow-up.

title: Surgical Pathology - Colon polyp
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
SPECIMEN: Sigmoid colon polyp, cold snare polypectomy.
CLINICAL HISTORY: Screening colonoscopy, 6 mm sessile polyp; r/o adenoma vs hyperplastic polyp.
GROSS: Received in formalin, a single tan polypoid fragment 0.6 x 0.4 x 0.3 cm, entirely submitted.
MICROSCOPIC: Serrated crypts confined to the upper portion of the mucosa with normal basal proliferative zone. No dysplasia. No sessile serrated features.
DIAGNOSIS:
Sigmoid colon, polypectomy: HYPERPLASTIC POLYP. Negative for dysplasia and malignancy.
rationale: Benign hyperplastic polyp; history mentions differential only.

title: 병리 결과 - 위 내시경 생검
text:
병리진단 보고서
검체: Stomach, antrum, endoscopic biopsy (x4)
임상정보: 위내시경상 antrum 2.5 cm ulcerofungating lesion, r/o EGC vs AGC.

육안소견: 0.2~0.4 cm 크기 조직편 4개.

현미경소견 및 진단:
Stomach, antrum, endoscopic biopsy:
 ADENOCARCINOMA, poorly differentiated (with signet ring cell component).
 Lauren: diffuse type.
 HER2 IHC: 추가 시행 예정 (addendum으로 보고).
rationale: Gastric adenocarcinoma: notification and referral.

title: Surgical Pathology - Breast core biopsy
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
SPECIMEN: Left breast, 2 o'clock, 6 cm FN, US-guided 14G core needle biopsy (5 cores).
CLINICAL HISTORY: 1.4 cm irregular mass, BI-RADS 5.
DIAGNOSIS:
Left breast, 2 o'clock, core biopsy:
- INVASIVE DUCTAL CARCINOMA (invasive carcinoma of no special type), Nottingham grade 2 (tubules 3, nuclei 2, mitoses 1).
- Ductal carcinoma in situ, intermediate grade, cribriform type, present.
- Lymphovascular invasion: not identified.
BIOMARKERS: ER positive (95%, strong), PR positive (60%), HER2 1+ (negative), Ki-67 15%.
Concordant with imaging. Results communicated to ordering provider via EHR inbox.
rationale: Invasive breast carcinoma: notification and referral (inbox message is not a referral).

title: Surgical Pathology - CT-guided lung biopsy
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
SPECIMEN: Right upper lobe nodule, CT-guided 18G core biopsy (3 cores).
CLINICAL HISTORY: 1.5 cm RUL nodule, PET SUV 3.1. Differential diagnosis: primary lung adenocarcinoma vs. carcinoid vs. granulomatous infection.
MICROSCOPIC: Lung parenchyma with well-formed necrotizing granulomas with central caseous-type necrosis and surrounding epithelioid histiocytes and multinucleated giant cells. GMS and AFB stains negative for organisms. No atypical epithelial cells.
DIAGNOSIS:
Lung, right upper lobe, CT-guided core biopsy:
- NECROTIZING GRANULOMATOUS INFLAMMATION.
- Special stains (AFB, GMS) negative for microorganisms.
- NEGATIVE FOR MALIGNANCY.
Comment: Correlation with cultures is recommended.
rationale: Benign granulomatous inflammation; malignancy appears only in the clinical differential.

title: 갑상선 세침흡인 세포검사
text:
세포병리 보고서
검체: Thyroid, right lobe, US-guided FNA
임상정보: Rt thyroid 1.7 cm nodule, TI-RADS TR5.

진단:
Thyroid, right, FNA:
 Bethesda category VI — MALIGNANT.
 Papillary thyroid carcinoma.
 (nuclear grooves, intranuclear pseudoinclusions, papillary fragments 관찰됨)
rationale: Bethesda VI papillary carcinoma: notification and referral.

title: Cytopathology - Thyroid FNA
text:
CYTOPATHOLOGY REPORT
SPECIMEN: Left thyroid nodule, 2.7 cm, US-guided FNA (3 passes).
CLINICAL HISTORY: TR3 nodule above 2.5 cm FNA threshold. Rule out follicular neoplasm.
ADEQUACY: Satisfactory for evaluation.
DIAGNOSIS:
BENIGN (Bethesda category II). Consistent with benign follicular nodule (adenomatoid/colloid nodule). Abundant colloid and benign-appearing follicular cells.
rationale: Bethesda II benign FNA.

title: Surgical Pathology - Prostate biopsy
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
SPECIMEN: A-L: Prostate, systematic 12-core biopsy; M-N: MRI-targeted biopsy, left PZ mid (PI-RADS 4 lesion).
DIAGNOSIS:
M-N. Prostate, left PZ mid, MRI-targeted biopsy:
 - PROSTATIC ADENOCARCINOMA, Gleason score 3+4=7 (Grade Group 2), involving 2 of 2 cores, 45% and 30% of core length. Pattern 4: 20%. Perineural invasion present.
A-L. Systematic cores: Left mid lateral: Prostatic adenocarcinoma Gleason 3+3=6 (Grade Group 1), 1 of 12 cores, 10%. Remaining cores benign prostatic tissue.
rationale: Prostate adenocarcinoma: notification and urology/oncology referral.

title: 피부 생검
text:
병리진단
검체: Skin, back, punch biopsy (4 mm)
임상정보: 0.8 cm pigmented lesion, r/o melanoma vs seborrheic keratosis.

진단:
Skin, back, punch biopsy:
 SEBORRHEIC KERATOSIS, pigmented (irritated type).
 Atypical melanocytic proliferation 없음. Margin free.
rationale: Benign seborrheic keratosis; melanoma only in history.

title: Surgical Pathology - Endometrial biopsy
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
SPECIMEN: Endometrium, office pipelle biopsy.
CLINICAL HISTORY: Postmenopausal bleeding, endometrial stripe 11 mm. R/O hyperplasia vs. carcinoma vs. atrophy.
DIAGNOSIS:
Endometrium, biopsy:
- ATYPICAL ENDOMETRIAL HYPERPLASIA / ENDOMETRIOID INTRAEPITHELIAL NEOPLASIA (EIN).
- No invasive carcinoma identified in this sample; a coexisting carcinoma cannot be excluded.
Comment: Gynecologic oncology referral is suggested.
rationale: Atypical hyperplasia/EIN (precancer, possible coexisting carcinoma) needs gynecology oncology referral.

title: 간 생검 병리
text:
병리진단 보고서
검체: Liver, S6, US-guided needle biopsy
임상정보: Multiple hepatic masses, primary unknown. r/o HCC vs metastasis.

진단:
Liver, needle biopsy:
 METASTATIC ADENOCARCINOMA.
 IHC: CK20(+), CDX2(+), CK7(-), SATB2(+) → c/w colorectal primary.

Comment: 하부위장관 내시경 검사 권함.
rationale: Metastatic adenocarcinoma: notification and referral.
